title: citronella costaricensis
intro: Citronella costaricensis, commonly known as West Indian lemongrass, is a species of grass native to Central and South America. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antifungal properties, which help to reduce fever, alleviate digestive issues, and soothe skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Citronella costaricensis include its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve circulation, and reduce stress, making it a popular natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include citronellal, limonene, and geraniol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and aromatherapeutic benefits.
